settings.about: Established by William Herron in 1989 and incorporated in 2005, Herron Engineering manufactures agricultural and industrial trailers, slurry tankers and spreading equipment in County Down. Products are designed, plasma cut, folded, welded and fitted in-house, with bespoke configurations available. Equipment is shot-blasted and finished with two-pack polyurethane paint.

services.title: Silage trailers
services.body: H1 and H2 silage trailers offer a choice of axle layouts and carrying capacities. Discuss the loads, terrain and unloading requirements with the sales team.

services.title: Grain and root crop trailers
services.short: Transport crops with a trailer specified around your work.
services.body: H1 and H2 crop trailer ranges combine different capacities with configuration options for individual customers and contractors.

services.title: Dump trailers
services.body: HDT and H2 dump trailers support agricultural and construction work. The range includes the H2 beavertail rear loader, combining a dump trailer and low loader.

services.title: Low loader trailers
services.body: Agricultural and industrial low loaders provide a choice of load capacities and configuration options. Contact the sales team about machinery dimensions and intended use.

services.title: Flat bed and bale trailers
services.short: Flexible transport for bales and other loads.
services.body: Agricultural and industrial flatbeds are offered for moving bales, boxes, pallets and materials, with different capacities and optional equipment.

services.title: Dropside tipping trailers
services.short: Compact and heavy duty multipurpose trailers.
services.body: Choose between the compact dropside range and heavy duty tipping trailers. Configuration options support a range of agricultural uses.

services.title: Feeding trailers
services.body: The feeding range includes cattle trailers with diagonal bars and sheep trailers with a cone-type floor. Ask about sizes and finishing options.

services.body: A wide range of trailer options covers hitches, braking systems, wheels, covers, loading equipment and storage. Compatibility should be confirmed for the selected trailer.

products.title: 12 Ton H2 BRL Beavertail Rear Loader
products.source_description: This innovative H2 model of a dumper and low loader in one. With a load capacity of 12 tonnes, it boasts a modern design, strength and durability. Extremely sturdy and exceptionally resilient during loading and unloading is the perfect choice for the most demanding customers. Main features include: • Internal beavertail built within the body to reduce height for ease of loading plant & machinery; • Low profile body to enable easy loading, slewing / rotation of plant & machinery, maximum stability, maneuverability and optimal field of vision for operator; • Hydraulic picture frame door – unique design dual function door within a door, with adjustable ramp mounting bar, dropping to form a ramp at 11° angle; • Durable lightweight ramps hook-on alloy ramps of 25kg each, storage trays underneath the body. For more information please contact our Sales Team or watch a review done by Grassmen https://youtu.be/p_2OznUOkOY

products.title: Trailing Shoe / Dribble Bar
products.source_description: Herron Engineering offer a 7.4m fully galvanised Trailing Shoe / Dribble Bar with a spring loaded ground attachment, 30 port Vogelsang macerator, mast type ‘A’ frame close fitting attachment and full electrics. The mast consists of a twin lift hydraulic ramp system and the ‘A’ frame attachment enables transferring weight onto the rear axle and putting more grip on the tractor. Its quick release mechanism is strong, reliable and convenient to attach / detach for the operator. It is supplied with an operational box that comprises of modules responsible for mast, boom, boom safety lock, blockage of manure switch etc. The overall exposure is only 800mm, which enables better maneuverability in restricted areas. The Trailing Shoe injects slurry into the ground without damaging crop roots. It decreases losses and helps retain nutrients value in order to ensure maximum growth.  It also reduces smell and rising gases which makes it more environmentally friendly.
